Episode Info 👇
Show Name - Bokul- বকুল
Full Episode Number - 194

About the Serial:-
--------------------------

    Odity is a young educated woman grown up in an orphanage. Parent-identity-less Odity, by staying in the orphanage and studying, has now become a well-known doctor of the city. For Odity, the orphanage itself is everything; all her salary, every bit of money, she spends in the orphanage. The caretaker of the orphanage house, Kabita Baideu, sometimes says – “Don’t spend all your salary money only in the name of the orphanage, keep something for yourself too.” But Odity does not listen to her words; according to Odity, the orphanage made her into a selfsufficient woman, gave her a new identity, therefore whatever she does now will only be for the orphanage’s development.
 
      There is a famous businessman of the city named Anabil chaliha. He has many businesses, but his main business is buying land at cheap rates and selling it later at higher prices. He has two sons. The elder son, Nibedan, once lost his eyes because of his father’s mistake. From that day, simple and sincere Nibedan was seen differently by his father, who thought him weak and incapable of handling hardship. On the other hand, the younger son, aditya, is completely opposite. A reckless young man. There is a lot’s of love and affection between the two brothers. Though Nibedan cannot see with his own eyes, he sees the world through the vision of his brother. aditya never lets Nibedan feel his blindness — he takes him everywhere, introduces him to every little things, every environment, so that Nibedan never feels different. 

    One day, Anabil Chilha’s eyes fell on the land of the orphanage house. He tried every way to acquire it, but failed again and again. aditya also visited the orphanage and makes unnecessary noise there, and that is how he met Odity. Slowly, conflict between the two escalated. One day, Aditya was injured in an accident and was admitted to the hospital where Odity worked. The responsibility of treatment fell on Odity. At first, she treated him only out of duty, but gradually some small incidents changed her thoughts about Aditya. Their bond moved from enmity towards love. And later she became the daughter in law of Anabil chaliha. 

    Kalyani was the elder daughter-in-law of Anabil chaliha. Born into a Poor family, being an educated girl, she had married Nivedan under certain circumstances. She found it difficult to accept a blind young man as her husband. Though she always kept a smile on her face, inside she was restless, and she wanted to make Anabil Chilha’s wealth her own together with her brother. After Odity entered the family as Aditya’s beloved, Kalyani realized her dream would not be fulfilled. She began to suffer mental anguish. And One day, after many conspiracies she was able to thrown Odity out of the house. This incident increased the conflict between the two brothers. 

   Odity is now unable to return to the orphanage house because Anabil Chaliha made the land his own at the same time. The people of the ashram now misunderstood Odity because Odity is now Anabil Chaliha's daughter-in-law.  

   After the incident, Odity and Aditya left the house, and their mother tried hard to bring them back because of her love for her youngest son but without success. Meanwhile, Anabil Chaliha became an enemy to Odity. One day, he conspired together with a doctor from the same hospital to defame her and able fired her from her job. The slander was serious enough for her to get a job in a private nursing home also. Aditya mother helped them from time to time, but that was not enough. They both began their struggling lives. Despite being a doctor and the son of a wealthy businessman in the city, they continued their struggling lives by opening a small food stall on the sidewalk.

snippet.title: Broncano le explica a Abascal por qué le han dejado a Vox elegir al público de La Revuelta
snippet.description:
La entrevista de Santiago Abascal en La Revuelta comenzó con una explicación de David Broncano que terminó convirtiéndose en una de las imágenes más significativas de la noche. El presentador reconoció ante el líder de Vox y el público que el partido había asumido la gestión de los espectadores que ocuparían las butacas del Teatro Albéniz.

La decisión respondía al temor de que el público habitual del programa, mayoritariamente de izquierdas, recibiera a Abascal entre abucheos e interrupciones. El objetivo, explicó Broncano, era evitar que el dirigente pudiera escudarse en un ambiente hostil para eludir las preguntas.

Sin embargo, la solución terminó generando un problema todavía mayor: permitir que el partido invitado decidiera quién escuchaba a su líder. Una circunstancia que podía transmitir una imagen de respaldo social que no necesariamente se corresponde con la realidad.

El propio Broncano admitió sus dudas sobre la decisión y reconoció que aquel público podía dar la impresión de que las opiniones de Abascal estaban siendo "validadas".

La neutralidad no consiste en entregar el control al invitado. Y aquella explicación anticipó una de las grandes contradicciones de la entrevista: para recibir a Abascal, La Revuelta había empezado renunciando a parte de su propia identidad.

11月8日に愛知県で最大震度5強を観測した地震。店舗のショーウインドーでガラスが割れるなどの被害を受け、各地で点検・確認作業が行われています。

愛知県で最大震度5強を観測した地震では、きょう10日、新たに1人のけが人が確認され、県内では合わせて20人となっています。

（矢野司記者）
「自動車販売店ではガラスが粉々に砕け、外に散乱しています。（店舗前に）規制線が張られ、撤去作業が行われています」

建物への被害は14棟に上っていて、震度4を観測した豊橋市の自動車販売店では、ショーウインドーのガラスが全面粉々に割れました。

震度4を観測 安城市のガラス張りの複合施設では…

同じく震度4を観測した安城市では…

（桜沢信司気象予報士）
「こちらは市の施設ですが、一面ガラス張り。2階もせり出していてガラス張りです」

図書館や商業施設・イベント広場などがある、複合施設「アンフォーレ」。高さ3メートルを超える大きさのガラスが一面に使われていて、人々はガラスの真横や真下を行き交います。10日、市の職員が建物に異常がないか見回りを行いました。

（安城市危機管理課 前田晃佑さん）
「他の市でガラスが割れているところを見たので、もしかしたら（この施設も）危ないのではないかと思った」
Q.実際に被害はあった？
「無事でした」

Q.何か対策は？
「ガラスの一部に飛散防止フィルムを貼って、安全確保に努めている」

飛散防止フィルムなど安全対策 南海トラフへ備え強化

出入り口などのガラスには飛散防止フィルムを貼っていて、それ以外の場所では厚いガラスを使用した上で、揺れの力がガラスに伝わりにくい方法で固定するなどの安全対策をしていると言います。それでも、いつか来ると言われる「南海トラフ巨大地震」に対しては…

（安城市危機管理課 前田晃佑さん）
「もっと激しい揺れと被害が起きることを想像すると、もっと備えをしっかりしないといけないかと。皆さんにも、意識啓発しないといけないと感じました」
